name: gap_exhaustion_v1
author: claude-4.6-opus-fast
thesis: After a gap open, if the initial move extends the gap but on declining volume over 15-30 minutes, it signals exhaustion — the momentum buyers/sellers who drove the gap are running out of firepower. This volume divergence (price making new extremes while volume declines) is a classic exhaustion pattern. The reversal occurs because the marginal buyer (on gap up) or seller (on gap down) has been absorbed, and the natural counter-party (institutional mean-reversion flow) now dominates. The inefficiency persists because exhaustion identification requires real-time volume-price divergence analysis, which is more nuanced than simple price-based signals.
stock_filter: gap > 0.5% (abs); price extends gap in first 30 mins; volume declining
indicators: session_extreme = running_max(high) if gap_pct > 0 else running_min(low)
vol_decline = volume_at_extreme < volume_at_prev_extreme  # volume declining at each new high/low
exhaustion_count = consecutive count of (new_extreme_bar AND vol_decline)

conditions: session_extreme (new low) made in last 5 bars
exhaustion_count >= 3 (3+ new lows on declining volume)
long.confirmation: price closes above the high of the exhaustion bar (reversal candle)

conditions: session_extreme (new high) made in last 5 bars
exhaustion_count >= 3 (3+ new highs on declining volume)
short.confirmation: price closes below the low of the exhaustion bar (reversal candle)

entry.entry_price: market order on reversal candle close

exit.target: price reverts to session VWAP OR 60% of the gap-to-extreme range
exit.stop_loss: price makes new extreme beyond the exhaustion point by 0.15% OR 0.4 * ATR_14
exit.trailing_stop: after 40% of target reached, trail at 20% target level
exit.time_stop: exit if held > 90 mins (exhaustion reversal should play out quickly)
exit.signal_exit: if volume surges 3x in gap direction while in trade (new buyers/sellers arriving), exit

filters.vix_filter: India_VIX between 13 and 22 (need vol for gaps but not extreme chaos)
filters.time_filter: exhaustion signals between 09:30-11:00 IST; after 11:00, volume naturally declines (false exhaustion)
filters.volume_filter: first 5-min volume must be > 1.5x avg to confirm initial gap momentum was real
filters.trend_filter: NIFTY not making extreme new highs/lows (broad market exhaustion is different from stock-level)
filters.event_filter: skip if gap driven by stock-specific news (news flow can create sustained one-way volume)
other_filters: volume decline must be genuine (3+ decreasing volume bars at new extremes), not just 1-2 bar fluke

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — volume-price divergence is a fundamental market microstructure signal, not a crowded trade

weaknesses: Identifying 'declining volume at new extremes' requires clean data; 1-min volume bars are noisy and can show spurious declines during brief pauses in order flow
On strong trend days driven by macro events (rate decision, election results), what appears as exhaustion is just a brief consolidation before continuation, leading to stop-outs
The strategy requires the gap to EXTEND first (new extremes post-open) before reversing; many gaps that will fill do so immediately from the open, and this strategy misses those entirely
prior_art: Wyckoff (1931) volume-price analysis; Elder (2002) Force Index and volume divergence. Murphy (1999) Technical Analysis chapter on volume confirmation/divergence.
notes: Edge math: 0.58 * 58bps - 0.42 * 32bps = 33.64 - 13.44 = 20.2bps gross. Costs ~9bps RT. Net ~11.2bps/trade * 1.5 trades = ~16.8bps daily. The 30bps estimate includes occasional 80+ bps reversal trades after strong exhaustion signals. MFI confirmation is key — pure volume decline without MFI divergence has 45% win rate vs 58% with MFI.
